crossRefs.note: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.
Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the…
for our God is a consuming fire.

translations.web: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
translations.bsb: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
translations.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
translations.asv: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
